nodes.label: Taste
nodes.rationale: The heading describes Taste as continuously learned by CommandCode.

nodes.label: Core Monitoring
nodes.rationale: Core monitoring is described as fully local; cloud reports and diagnostics are optional.

nodes.label: Prebuilt Assets
nodes.rationale: The repository guide says there is no build step because the assets ship pre-built.

nodes.label: AI Diagnostics
nodes.rationale: The README presents AI diagnostics as an optional cloud feature, off by default.

nodes.label: SitePulse
nodes.rationale: SitePulse is described as a WordPress plugin for finding performance bottlenecks and guiding investigation.

nodes.label: Automated Test Setup
nodes.rationale: The repository has no test runner or linter; its documented manual runtime check uses WordPress Playground.
